name: cc-auto-review
description: A desktop app that reviews GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code

scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.app:build: bun run build && tauri build --bundles app
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && biome format . && bun test
scripts.app:dmg: bun run build && tauri build --bundles dmg
scripts.app:build:x64: bun run build:client && bun scripts/build-server.ts x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.app:dmg:x64: bun run build:client && bun scripts/build-server.ts x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
scripts.app:build:universal: bun run build:client && bun scripts/build-server.ts universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app
scripts.app:dmg:universal: bun run build:client && bun scripts/build-server.ts universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
scripts.app:build:linux: bun run build && tauri build --bundles deb,appimage
